thread:
sarah: Heads-up — OrbitX POC is ramping and they're seeing a mix of 429s and intermittent 503s when they hit ~500 rps. Security questionnaire still has an open data-retention Q. Need a short war-room to unblock by EOD. @maria can you grab logs? @alex can we temporarily raise their pool/burst? @rajesh pls prep pricing for burst scenario.

maria: On it. Quick triage shows correlation between 429s on the API route and a few 503s with kv cache OOMs. Pasting the two lines that jumped out: 

```
[2026-03-21T14:12:05Z] req=0xabc status=503 runtime_error=kv_cache_oom model=redwood-v1 seq=2048
[2026-03-21T14:12:05Z] req=0xdef status=429 reason=rate_limit_exceeded route=api/generate
```

maria: Also noticing many of the 429s are at the gateway layer (auth/token) — could be per-key burst throttling + client retry pattern. :eyes:

alex: We can do a short-term mitigant: add 2 temporary replicas to their dedicated pool and extend the burst window to 60s. That should absorb the spike and reduce kv pressure. Need infra approval to override autoscaler.

jon: I can run the autoscale override now. Calling the override API.

deploy-bot: autoscale-override job started (job_id=48392) — adding 2 replicas to pool orbitx-pool-01, burst_window=60s. ETA ~45s.

deploy-bot: autoscale-override job complete — replicas=+2, burst_window set.

alex: Also enabling prefix cache for this customer session to reduce KV churn. Patch applied to canary: 
```
runtime.config.prefix_cache.enabled = true
runtime.config.prefix_cache.size = 2GB
```

maria: Canary logs after canary patch: 503s dropped to near-zero, 429s decreased but still present. Raw counters: pre-patch 429=47% of requests in window, post-patch 429=18% (5m window).

rajesh: Pricing note for OrbitX ask (sustained 500rps, ~10k tokens/day bursty): rough monthly estimate based on hosted units + reserved burst = "$5k/month baseline + $1.8k for burst buffer" — I'll formalize and attach a quote. Need to confirm if they want committed reserved capacity or pay-as-you-go for bursts.

security-bot: Security questionnaire update: Q5 (data retention & deletion) unanswered. Customer legal requires confirmation of retention period and deletion flow before signing. Sarah — can legal sign off by EOD?

sarah: I'll ping legal and send retention policy. Plan: provide written retention + deletion flow by 18:00 PT, and ask for e-signature. @rajesh pls flag any contract language changes.

maria: Ops suggestion — throttle client retry behavior at the gateway (add exponential backoff + jitter) to avoid retry storms. Sending runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-troubleshooting

alex: Monitoring gates in place. Added a temporary alert: if 503 rate > 5% in 5m, page oncall. Canaries stable for last 3m, 5xx ~0.8%.

jon: Confirming metrics on grafana: CPU and GPU load increased as expected, no OOMs on canary. Rolling change to prod pool in 10m if stable.

rajesh: Quote draft uploaded to shared drive, sending to sarah for approval. Also included a 30-day free burst credit to help their ramp.

security-bot: Received retention policy doc from sarah. Security review queued — ETA 3 hours. Noted: need a signed addendum if retention exceeds 90 days.

sarah: Thanks everyone. Next actions: (1) security answer + sign-off by 18:00 (sarah), (2) formal pricing + contract send by EOD (rajesh), (3) monitor 24h and then hand off to CSM once stable (maria/alex). I’ll update OrbitX with a short summary in 30m. :thumbsup:

maria: quick note — recommend we ship client-side retry guidance in the POC README to avoid repeated bursts. Small docs PR coming.

sarah: Perfect. Great triage — appreciate the fast help.

jon: Will keep the autoscale override live for 2 hours, then we can reassess.

alex: Leaving the prefix cache and burst window in place for now. Will revert if any regressions.

sarah: Closing thread for now — moving to monitor channel in 1h. Will DM owners for any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
